pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ bhattena nimantesi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.4: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto purebhattaṃ kulāni payirupāsati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.5: atha kho te bhikkhū te manusse etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.7: āgametha bhante yāv' ayyo Upanando āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.9: tatiyam pi kho te bhikkhū te manusse etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.11: tatiyam pi kho mayaṃ bhante bhattaṃ karimhā ayyassa Upanandassa kāraṇā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.12: āgametha bhante yāv' ayyo Upanando āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.13: atha kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto purebhattaṃ kulāni payirupāsitvā divā āgacchati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.16: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto nimantito sabhatto samāno purebhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjissatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.17: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Upananda nimantito . . . āpajjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.20: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa nimantito . . . āpajjissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.21: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.22: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.23.1: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno purebhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.24: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ saṃghass' atthāya khādaniyaṃ pāhesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.2: ayyassa Upanandassa dassetvā saṃghassa dātabban ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭho hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.4: atha kho te manussā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhū pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.6: es' āvuso āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭho 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.7: idaṃ bhante khādaniyaṃ ayyassa Upanandassa dassetvā saṃghassa dātabban ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.9: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.10: tena hi bhikkhave paṭiggahetvā nikkhipatha yāva Upanando āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.11: atha kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ purebhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjitun ti pacchābhattaṃ kulāni payirupāsitvā divā paṭikkami. khādaniyaṃ ussādiyittha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.13: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto pacchābhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjissatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.14: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Upananda pacchābhattaṃ . . . āpajjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.17: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa pacchābhattaṃ . . . āpajjissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.18: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.19: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.20.1: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.21: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū cīvaradānasamaye kukkuccāyantā kulāni na payirupāsanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:3.6.1: yo pana bhikkhu . . . āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:3.7: tatthāyaṃ samayo, cīvaradānasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū cīvarakammaṃ karonti attho ca hoti sūciyāpi suttena pi satthakena pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:4.6.1: yo pana bhikkhu . . . āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:4.7: tatthāyaṃ samayo: cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo. ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū gilānā honti attho ca hoti bhesajjehi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:5.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave santaṃ bhikkhuṃ āpucchā kulāni payirupāsituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:5.6.1: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:5.7: tatthāyaṃ samayo: cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti. ||5||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.1.16: yena nimantito antamaso kusaggena pi bhuttaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.1.18: cattāri kulāni khattiyakulaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ vessakulaṃ suddakulaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.1.21: paṭhamaṃ pādaṃ ummāraṃ atikkāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.1.26: anatthate kaṭhine vassānassa pacchimo māso, atthate kaṭhine pañca māsā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.2.1: nimantite nimantitasaññī santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ pacchābhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati aññatra samayā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
